title: Shot History Export Schema
description: JSON export of one shot (Shot History card download and Shot Analyzer export). It is the parsed binary shot log (/api/history/<6-digit id>.slog, see shot_log_format.h) merged with its shot index entry and notes. Exporters may add further client-side fields.

exitReason.description: Why a phase or shot ended: 0 unknown/legacy, 1 volumetric target, 2 pressure target, 3 flow target, 4 pumped-water target, 5 phase duration, 6 safety timeout, 7 manually stopped, 8 hold released (hold-to-flush), 9 ratio target

sampleIndex.description: Index of the first sample of this phase

phaseNumber.description: Zero-based index of the phase in the profile

phaseName.description: Phase name from the profile (max. 24 bytes UTF-8)

systemInfo.description: Decoded per-sample system flags (shot log v2+)

extendedRecording.description: Sample was recorded after the pump stopped, while the scale weight settles

activeScaleConnected.description: Any scale (Bluetooth or hardware) connected; mirrors bluetoothScaleConnected before shot log v8

phaseNumber.description: Zero-based profile phase index (shot log v5+)

phaseDisplayNumber.description: One-based phase number for display (shot log v5+)

id.description: Shot id without zero padding (e.g. "31"); the log file is the zero-padded id (000031.slog)

version.description: Binary shot log format version (SHOT_LOG_VERSION, currently 8)

volume.description: Final weight (g): notes doseOut override, then recorded final weight, then last sample; null if unknown

rating.description: Rating from the shot index; null (or 0 in imported files) when unrated

incomplete.description: Shot log was not finalized (power loss, still recording, truncated file)

avgTemp.description: Average temperature from the shot index (°C)

maxPressure.description: Peak pressure from the shot index (bar)

avgFlow.description: Average positive pump flow from the shot index (ml/s)

fieldsMask.description: Bit mask of recorded sample fields (shot_log_format.h)

trailingBytes.description: Bytes after the last complete sample (non-zero means truncated)

samplesExpected.description: Sample count from the log header; 0 if not finalized

phaseTransitions.description: Phase starts with exit reasons (shot log v5+, max. 12)

finalExitReason.description: Why the shot ended (last phase exit or manual stop; shot log v5+)

brewDelay.description: Predictive brew stop delay the shot ran with (ms)

notes.description: Shot notes, or null when none were loaded

loaded.description: Web UI state; always true in exports

data.description: Web UI state; always null in exports
